result.scope: CPU FP32, actual8k no-DINO EMA copied into an isolated process; one fixed generated32px training fixture with four CFA patterns and new seed902267.128 fresh AdamW updates atconstant2e-4, clip1, production reconstruction loss. No held-out image, benchmark fixture or user photo is used. No learned weights saved or used for a quality run. Overfitting this easy example is an optimization sanity check, not denoising generalization, GPU-AMP parity or model-quality evidence.

GPU_diagnostic_observed_status.scope: One generated fixed 32px training fixture, all four CFA patterns, seed902267/902268; same fixture as isolated CPU sanity check. Two independent copies of actual8k EMA, fresh AdamW, all learned weights discarded. No training/validation/private-photo input, model promotion, quality continuation, generalization claim or production compute-policy change. Inference-only raw-vs-EMA and FP32/BF16/FP16 comparisons precede optimization. Do not attribute all floating-point differences to rounding alone; CUDA kernels/layout differ from CPU.

decision: Neither fresh RAW8k endpoint is promoted. Do not extend or change production precision based on early mean gains. V43 remains working/README reference. Entire original horizon was160000 updates; this is8000, only5%. Architecture/initialization/training budgets differ from mature RGB references; no isolated architecture-effect or convergence claim.
scope: All frozen primary, analytic/color/hue/artifact/supplementary/source-sensitivity stages completed and owner exited. Actual visual notes cover14 published originals and6 additional viewed hue originals, not every produced image. Final protected RAW scenes remain unscored. Neither model promoted or automatically continued. Separate discarded precision diagnostic does not alter quality checkpoints.

hue_grid.scope: 24 fixed scene-linear HSV hues at15degree intervals, saturation.5/.98, peak.02/.18/.9, plus3grays; two noise conditions and4CFAs, one draw/case. Fixed WB/camera, no clipping, original16bit ADC/black.03. Chosen after parent color failures but frozen before treatment scoring when workflow supplied; finite diagnostic grid, not a natural-photo ranking or independent training-repeat sample.
